P&C Stocks Worth Owning: The AI Hedge with Ryan Tunis | The Real Eisman Playbook Episode 74

Ryan Tunis explains the P&C pricing cycle, distribution moats and the move toward softer premiums. He favors Travelers, AIG and brokers, while warning about auto insurance and Kinsale. Eisman adopts the personal-lines caution and reiterates AIG and Trupanion views, but does not adopt the broker recommendation. Primary evidence supports safer cars reducing claims and AIG operational progress. Trupanion cash generation is materially stronger than the simple $30-40m annual framing; stock-return outcomes remain unresolved.
